similarity.description: similar_to only: what the candidates were compared with and how.

images.description: Empty with image="none" or no candidates.

recommended_state_id.description: Canonical state to place; left out when it equals block_id (a block without properties).

candidate_qualification.description: Present only for a conditional candidate; absent means eligible.

score.description: Local deterministic relevance after the derived-shape factor and recommendation-list deprioritization. With similar_to it is the palette similarity alone (keywords then only filter the pool). Rounded to 2 decimals; ranking uses full precision.

score_breakdown.description: Dimensions the query asked for, each 0-1 and rounded to 2 decimals; only non-zero ones are listed, and the whole object is left out when none is. text: name/synonym/annotation word coverage; color: preview colour and stated colour; shape: registry-tag shape class; light: brightest emission level / 15. With similar_to: color is the palette similarity (1 identical, 0 at distance 0.25 or more) and text is the keyword score when keywords were given.

reason.description: With similar_to: "ΔE <colour distance>, texture <texture term>", explained once in similarity.basis.

color_series.description: Present when the query named no colour and other dye colours of this block's 16-colour series also matched; they are folded into this candidate. Substitute a colour into block_id_pattern for its block ID.

oxidation_series.description: Present when other oxidation stages or waxed versions of this copper block also matched and were folded into this candidate: waxed versions always (they look the same), other stages when the query named no colour. Not folded for an exact name or ID match.

image.description: Lossless WebP contact sheet, one tile per candidate labelled with its candidate_id and block_id without the minecraft: namespace ("T03 snow_block", wrapped after underscores when long). image="full" (default): 256x256 cards of the four views, label over the bottom margin; image="compact": the isometric and top views at 64px side by side (128 wide) above a label strip as tall as the longest label needs.

content_index.description: Index of the ImageContent in the tool result content array.

columns.description: Tiles per row. Tiles are row-major in candidate order: T01 is the first tile, so candidate n is at row (n-1) div columns, column (n-1) mod columns; tile width is width / columns and tile height is height / rows.
